layer_3_action.action: A cinematic landscape of a bright, sun-drenched valley. The ground is a warm buff color with striking orange rock formations. Light filters through a moderate canopy of ancient trees.

visuals.ground: Buff-colored sandy soil punctuated by rusty-orange ironstone nodules and outcrops. The surface is textured with low-growing ferns and moss patches. Absolutely no grass.
visuals.water: Sparkling, clear river water reflecting the bright blue sky and the warm tones of the sandstone banks.
visuals.sky: Bright, saturated blue sky visible through the 40% tree canopy; direct mid-day sunlight.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Granular sand, smooth ironstone nodules, and soft bryophyte mats.
